name: Thomas Waitz - Après le § 79 - Am 28
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on North Macedonia
part_text: 79b. Calls on all political actors of the country to unequivocally reject any form of historical revisionism or territorial claims against neighbouring countries, including irredentist rhetoric; underlines that good neighbourly relations must be grounded in the inviolability of borders and mutual respect;
